import json, subprocess, sys, os, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
env = dict(os.environ); env.pop('SCAMP_CORE', None)
rng = random.Random(31)
reqs=[]
for k in range(3):
    fib=[]; seen=set()
    while len(fib)<1024:
        L=rng.choice([128]*5+[96,64,48,32,16,8,0])
        net=(rng.getrandbits(L)<<(128-L)) if L else 0
        if (net,L) in seen: continue
        seen.add((net,L)); fib.append((net,L,rng.randrange(65536)))
    reqs.append(json.dumps({'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':ref.fmt(a)+'/%d'%l,'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],
                            'capacities':[10**9]*16,'max_stride':32}))
data='\n'.join(reqs)+'\n'
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submit/main.py'], input=data, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=400, env=env)
print('pyfallback compile x3 (1024 each): %.1fs rc=%d' % (time.time()-t0, p.returncode))
print(p.stderr[-300:] if p.returncode else '')
imgs=[json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]
for im in imgs: assert im['status']=='ok'
print('cuts0', imgs[0]['cuts'], 'used0', imgs[0]['used_bits'])
EOF
